⛔ anti-hall · devswarm-mesh-only: `hivecontrol workspace message-parent` is blocked.
Why: anti-hall's shared mesh store is the only agent-initiated messaging transport; a delegated send writes the native queue identically.
Do instead: `node scripts/devswarm.js send --to-primary --message-file <path>` (or `--to <meshId>`) to message, `node scripts/devswarm.js heartbeat <id> --summary "<text>"` to report status.
Override (only if the user explicitly asked): set DISABLE_ANTIHALL_DEVSWARM=1 to disable this guard entirely

err:
⛔ anti-hall · devswarm-read-guard: `hivecontrol workspace read-messages` is blocked.
Why: It mark-reads and drains the native queue, losing messages the durable inbox still needs.
Do instead: `devswarm.js inbox pull <id>` then `devswarm.js inbox read <id>` (durable cursor). Do not delegate this to a subagent either.
Allowed here: `message-count` reflects the NATIVE queue only; a 0 does not mean nothing is pending.
Override (only if the user explicitly asked): set DISABLE_ANTIHALL_DEVSWARM=1 to disable the read-guard entirely
